raw_events.description: A large, sudden explosion occurs behind the central palm tree, producing a massive fireball, rapidly expanding shockwave and debris cloud, followed by thick black and brown smoke obscuring the scene.
A large, violent explosion occurs with bright orange fireball and rapidly expanding dark smoke plume; debris is visibly ejected upward and outward in frames f0–f2.
Secondary detonation or continued energetic combustion: intense fire persists behind palm tree, with additional debris ejection and turbulent smoke expansion visible through f3–f5.

Ongoing explosive effects: sustained massive smoke column, ground disturbance (dust/debris cloud), and residual fire glow; no new ignition but dynamic aftermath consistent with recent high-energy blast (f6–f10).
